description:
Project purpose

We are developing a smartwatch prototype connected to a computer-based control interface.

The system aims to:

Display heart rate, estimated blood oxygen saturation, and surface temperature.

Send an SOS notification through a physical button.

Show incoming alerts on the watch and provide vibration feedback.

Highlight spacecraft faults in red on the interface.

Explain faults through text and speech

At this stage, this is an educational demonstration prototype.
